text:
mara: Quick design review request — thinking about adding live validation for function definitions in the Playground schema editor. lightweight: inline error badges, keyboard-first fixes, and an ARIA live region for screen readers. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example (WIP)

sasha: Love it. Two quick concerns: visual noise in run-history when many errors appear, and we need clear affordances for "fix in place" vs "open editor".

jonathan: Agree with sasha. Also we should avoid red-only indicators. Propose icon + underline + tooltip with short hint.

mara: Good call on color. Proposed microcopy for tooltip: "Schema mismatch — expected object with keys: prompt, timeout." Thoughts?

tia: Microcopy is fine. For SR: put text into an aria-live polite region and add a "Describe error" button that toggles expanded details. Keyboard: make F2 open inline edit; Escape cancels.

kevin: FWIW: if we show inline suggestions (eg. replace param type), ensure suggestions are reachable via arrow keys and Enter to apply. Also show small preview of how run result would change.

mara: Nice. UX question: should we autosave fixes from inline editor? my thought: no — require explicit "Apply" to keep run-history deterministic.

jonathan: +1 dont autosave. Also add an undo stack tied to the run entry so users can revert to the saved schema for that run.

sasha: Accessibility nit: ensure error badges have accessible names e.g. "Schema error: missing property 'user_id'" so VoiceOver reads it when focused.

tia: On contrast: the small pill badge needs higher contrast at 14px. Current figma uses #7A7A7A on #FFFFFF which fails AA for 14px. Recommend #333 on white or fill variant.

mara: noted. I'll update figma. Also thinking about compressing run-history: collapsed entries show a compact error summary, expand shows full inline editor. Any objections?

kevin: collapsing is good. Just preserve keyboard focus order when expanding/collapsing so user doesn't lose place.

jonathan: copy tweak: change "Fix suggestion" button to "Apply suggestion" — clearer intent.

sasha: small thing: avoid "error" in permanent badges — maybe "issue" or "mismatch" to reduce alarm.

mara: Hmm, I like "issue". less scary. will try both in mock.

ui-bot: poll created by mara: which label should we use? :issue: "Issue" (vote :one:), :error: "Error" (vote :two:). Poll ends in 24h.

mara: Implementation notes for eng: validator runs on blur + on-demand run check. debounce 400ms for typing. expose endpoints: POST /playground/validate-schema {schema} -> {issues}. keep response small (max 5 issues).

kevin: dev note: prefer server-side validation for consistency across clients, but keep quick client heuristics for instant feedback. We'll mirror server errors to the inline UI.

jonathan: For run-history compact view, show up to 2 inline issues in collapsed state, with "+N more" link. Clicking expands that run item.

tia: a11y test plan: keyboard nav tests, screen reader walkthroughs for VoiceOver + NVDA, and contrast checks. I'll draft a checklist.

mara: Thanks — actionables: sasha & mara update figma contrast + labels; kevin + eng to spec validator debounce + undo stack; tia drafts a11y checklist; jonathan to write copy variants for buttons/tooltips. I'll follow up with a short PR checklist.

sasha: cc @kevin for engineering sync tomorrow.

kevin: got it. I'll slot 30m.

mara: Awesome. Thanks all. :tada:
